messages:
Cam Nguyen: Quick sync 1: customer POC blocked. CPQ routed a 9-month commit with a 12% discount to Sales Ops. We intended >6 months to hit Deal Desk.
Jules Rivera: Oof. Which CPQ flag is doing the routing today?
Cam Nguyen: Theres `Price_Exception__c` only. No commit or ARR logic.
Maya Ortiz: Proposed change: compute `DealDeskRouteFlag__c` in CPQ with logic: if Commit_Months__c >= 6 OR Discount_Pct__c > 0.15 OR Legal_Amendment__c = TRUE -> true. Also set `DealDesk_Reason__c` to values: ["commit-length","discount-threshold","legal-term","security-qa","manual"].
Jules Rivera: I like keeping downstream simple. Also populate `Approval_SLA__c` tokens: '24h','48h','72h' based on Estimated_ARR__c: <=50k -> 24h; 50k-250k -> 48h; >250k or Legal_Amendment -> 72h. CPQ should set `SLA_Expires_At__c` timestamp = Now + Approval_SLA.
legal-bot: When Legal_Amendment__c = TRUE, include `Requested_Template_Id__c` and set `Legal_Priority__c`. Default templates: NDA_BASIC, SOW_MINI, ENTERPRISE_SOW.
Cam Nguyen: Operational ask: add `Deal_Route_Audit__c` (short text) with human-friendly reason and `Deal_Route_History__c` (long text) for troubleshooting.
Maya Ortiz: Escalation: if SLA_Expires_At__c < NOW() and Auto_Escalated__c = FALSE -> set Auto_Escalated__c = TRUE; post to #deal-desk-escalations and email DealDeskLead. We should also record `Escalation_Count__c`.
Jules Rivera: Example SOQL for validation in sandbox: ```sql
SELECT Id, Name, Commit_Months__c, Discount_Pct__c, DealDeskRouteFlag__c, DealDesk_Reason__c, Approval_SLA__c, SLA_Expires_At__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = 'OPP-2001'
```
Cam Nguyen: I'll open a ticket. Owners: Jules -> CPQ rule + sandbox patch; Maya -> SLA/escalation logic + test cases; LegalBot -> template list.
ops-bot: created ticket DD-1408 (owner: @Jules Rivera) https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DD-1408 :white_check_mark:
Maya Ortiz: ETA sandbox patch tomorrow morning. I'll post results and SOQL outputs here.
Cam Nguyen: Thanks. If sandbox looks good, flip in staging next week and update the sales playbook with exact SLA wording. :rocket:
